<!-- pr-reviewer: d18b8641bd56d4bc0ef9b810dc7742c4cbe06b67 -->

Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.

## What looks good

- All five posts declare the same three manifest fields and share one append-check in `block()`.
- The helper returns an empty text when Explain is off, so the off programs stay byte-identical. The tests prove this per post.
- The lathe keeps its own word meanings and the station/offset T word reading. The lathe pins prove this.
- Each test lives in `crates/post/tests/`, the lowest crate that provides its imports. Its gate map names the covered modules.
- The goldens under `crates/post/tests/golden/explain/` record only Explain-on output. No existing golden changed.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/1388-explain-fanuc-family.md` records the budget choice and the dropped options.
- The new suite fails on the unchanged posts with the missing-form refusal. This is a real pin, not a tautology.

## Results (built and run locally in a review worktree, at head d18b8641b, merged-clean check against main 8b297dcbd)

| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge with current main (`git merge-tree`) | 0 conflicts; GitHub says MERGEABLE / CLEAN |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --only post` | ok 109 s — 514 passed, 0 failed (all post suites, incl. the 10 new `explain_fanuc_family` pins) |
| `cargo xtask gate quick --only app` | ok 286 s — 487 passed, 0 failed (posting, `explain_option`, lathe_post suites among them; `crates/app/src/posting.rs` embeds the five changed posts) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

## Law checks

- Prime Directive: pass. An explanation that does not fit the 80-character budget is omitted whole. No executable word is cut or reordered. Comments stay inert text.
- No `unwrap()`, `expect()` or `panic!` in new non-test code. The new `expect()` calls are in test files only.
- No new components; `schema.rs` untouched. No new user-facing command, so no MCP row owed.
- No new inter-crate dependency; no Cargo.toml / Cargo.lock / build.rs / .github / scripts / xtask change.
- CHANGELOG.md untouched; no snapshot PNG changed; no UI string changed.
- Provenance lines present on the new test file; the posts carry the `#1388` note. The 400-line rule exempts the `.cps` scripts.
- Clean-room: pass. Word meanings come from RS-274 / ISO 6983 and the LinuxCNC reference, already recorded in the engine module.

## Requested before merge

None.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

1. Issue 1388 says "no block exceeds the post's stated line length". The posts state a budget for added explanations only; a pre-existing long executable block stays intact by design. The decision file records this reading.
2. In the lathe golden, the `G21 G18 G40 G80 G99` comment is cut at the 60-character comment cap, so G99's lathe meaning is dropped from that line. The engine's documented cap behaviour causes this, not this PR.
3. PRs #468, #517 and #518 touch `fanuc-lathe.cps` in other functions and stay open. The merge planner should order them; whichever merges second refreshes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
